rejection_summary.title: The Big 4
rejection_summary.reason: Although the film has exuberant gunplay and comic violence, its 141-minute runtime and the prominent Rotten Tomatoes-cited RogerEbert.com criticism of an overlong, talky structure make sustained action density less convincing than the selected alternatives; https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/the_big_4.

rejection_summary.title: Revenger
rejection_summary.reason: Its prison-island martial arts battles are striking, but AsianMovieWeb describes long gaps after the introduction, action picking up only around the 30-minute mark and extended pauses later; this conflicts with claims of virtually nonstop combat. Not prioritized without reliable whole-runtime density; https://www.asianmovieweb.com/de/reviews/revenger.htm.
